title: JMAP draft: Room/create takes the room ID as an argument; room_metadata optional
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 Room/create rule 5 reads the new room's ID from the room metadata's room_uri, so every JMAP-created room carries room_metadata (0x0023). mls-extensions-11 §5 then makes it a required component (state in the GroupContext must be listed in app_components; every member's leaf must list it), so users whose clients don't support 0x0023 (Haven's KeyPackages list 0x21, 0x22, 0x25, 0x27) can't be added. protocol-07 §7.6 makes room metadata optional descriptive data. Change the draft: roomId is a Room/create argument (roomIdPrefix + base32 of 16 octets, as now), room_metadata MAY be present and, if present, its room_uri MUST equal roomId. Found 2026-11-15 (mimid-1wgh.46.18); Mark: the bug is ours, not Haven's.
close_reason: jmap-chat-spec a8934c3 + 06e773a: roomId argument, metadata optional, app_components note.
